title: Untitled (Planes, Discs, Chess)
description: Dense mixed-media collage combining multiple top-down warplane silhouettes, compact discs, chess pieces, concentric-ring targets, and ribbon stripes across a white ground. Iridescent foil strips, red diagonal bands, and scattered roundels fill the picture plane in layered vertical arrangement.
composition: dense vertical layering across full picture plane
keywords: compact disc target roundel mixed media
